"""Request and response schemas of authors."""

from datetime import date
from typing import ClassVar
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field

from app.validators import ApiModel, ResponseModel


class AuthorCreate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that creates or replaces an author."""

    name: str = Field(..., min_length=2, max_length=120)
    email: EmailStr | None = None
    born: date | None = None


class AuthorUpdate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that changes part of an author: only the fields sent change."""

    name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=2, max_length=120)
    email: EmailStr | None = None
    born: date | None = None

    non_nullable: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"name"})


class Author(ResponseModel):
    """An author as the API returns it."""

    id: UUID
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=2, max_length=120)
    email: EmailStr | None = None
    born: date | None = None


class AuthorPage(BaseModel):
    """One page of authors."""

    items: list[Author]
    total: int
    page: int
    size: int

"""Request and response schemas of books."""

from datetime import date
from typing import ClassVar
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.shared.schemas import Genre
from app.validators import ApiModel, ResponseModel


class BookCreate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that creates or replaces a book."""

    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
    isbn: str = Field(..., pattern="^[0-9]{13}$")
    author_id: UUID = Field(..., alias="authorId")
    genre: Genre
    pages: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=5000)
    published: date | None = None
    available: bool | None = True

    non_nullable: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"available"})


class BookUpdate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that changes part of a book: only the fields sent change."""

    title: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    isbn: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern="^[0-9]{13}$")
    author_id: UUID | None = Field(default=None, alias="authorId")
    genre: Genre | None = None
    pages: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=5000)
    published: date | None = None
    available: bool | None = None

    non_nullable: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"title", "isbn", "author_id", "genre", "pages", "available"})


class Book(ResponseModel):
    """A book as the API returns it."""

    id: UUID
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
    isbn: str = Field(..., pattern="^[0-9]{13}$")
    author_id: UUID = Field(..., alias="authorId")
    genre: Genre
    pages: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=5000)
    published: date | None = None
    available: bool


class BookPage(BaseModel):
    """One page of books."""

    items: list[Book]
    total: int
    page: int
    size: int

"""Configuration read from the environment. Nothing secret has a default: see .env.example."""

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    """Values the application needs from its environment."""

    jwt_secret: str
    jwt_algorithm: str
    jwt_audience: str | None
    jwt_issuer: str | None


def get_settings() -> Settings:
    """Reads the settings on every call, so a changed environment (tests, reloads) is always seen."""
    return Settings(
        jwt_secret=os.environ.get("JWT_SECRET", ""),
        jwt_algorithm=os.environ.get("JWT_ALGORITHM", "HS256"),
        jwt_audience=os.environ.get("JWT_AUDIENCE") or None,
        jwt_issuer=os.environ.get("JWT_ISSUER") or None,
    )

"""Entry point of the API: run it with "uvicorn app.main:app --reload"."""

from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.author.repository import InMemoryAuthorRepository
from app.author.router import router as author_router
from app.book.repository import InMemoryBookRepository
from app.book.router import router as book_router
from app.errors import register_error_handlers


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    """Builds the application: error format, storage and the routes of every resource."""
    app = FastAPI(
        title="library-api",
        version="0.1.0",
        description="REST API generated by Model2API. Review it before using it in production.",
    )
    register_error_handlers(app)
    # Data kept in memory while the application runs; restarting it starts empty
    app.state.repositories = {
        "author": InMemoryAuthorRepository(),
        "book": InMemoryBookRepository(),
    }
    app.include_router(author_router)
    app.include_router(book_router)
    return app


app = create_app()

"""Bearer token authentication. Tokens are issued by your identity provider; this API only verifies them
with JWT_SECRET (and JWT_AUDIENCE / JWT_ISSUER when set) and reads the roles from the "roles" claim."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, Security
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer

from app.config import get_settings
from app.errors import ForbiddenError, UnauthorizedError

_bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False, scheme_name="bearer")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Principal:
    """Who made the request, as the token says."""

    subject: str
    roles: frozenset[str]


def current_principal(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Security(_bearer)) -> Principal:
    """Verifies the token: signature, expiry (required) and, when configured, audience and issuer.
    Without JWT_SECRET, every request is rejected."""
    settings = get_settings()
    if credentials is None or not settings.jwt_secret:
        raise UnauthorizedError()
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(
            credentials.credentials,
            settings.jwt_secret,
            algorithms=[settings.jwt_algorithm],
            audience=settings.jwt_audience,
            issuer=settings.jwt_issuer,
            options={"require": ["exp"]},
        )
    except jwt.PyJWTError as error:
        raise UnauthorizedError() from error
    roles = claims.get("roles", [])
    if isinstance(roles, str):
        roles = [roles]
    return Principal(subject=str(claims.get("sub", "")), roles=frozenset(str(role) for role in roles))


def require_roles(*roles: str):
    """A dependency that lets the request through only if the token has one of `roles`."""

    def dependency(principal: Principal = Depends(current_principal)) -> Principal:
        if not principal.roles.intersection(roles):
            raise ForbiddenError()
        return principal

    return dependency

# library-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with FastAPI. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Python 3.11 or later.

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate        # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
cp .env.example .env             # then fill in your values
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --env-file .env
```

The interactive documentation is at http://localhost:8000/docs, and the contract in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
pytest
```

The tests call every endpoint with an empty storage.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/authors` | List authors | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/authors/{id}` | Get an author | 200 | roles: admin, reader |
| `POST` | `/authors` | Create an author | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/authors/{id}` | Replace an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/authors/{id}` | Update part of an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/authors/{id}` | Delete an author | 204 | roles: admin |
| `GET` | `/books` | List books | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/books/{id}` | Get a book | 200 | roles: admin, reader |
| `POST` | `/books` | Create a book | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/books/{id}` | Replace a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/books/{id}` | Update part of a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/books/{id}` | Delete a book | 204 | roles: admin |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

Data is kept in memory while the application runs and is lost when it stops. Replace the repositories in `app/dependencies.py` to use a database.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a bearer token issued by your identity provider. The API verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` (and `JWT_AUDIENCE` / `JWT_ISSUER` when set), requires an expiry, and reads the roles from the `roles` claim. It does not issue tokens.

## Structure

```text
app/
  main.py, config.py, errors.py, dependencies.py, validators.py
  shared/schemas.py     enums and embedded objects
  <resource>/           schemas, repository, service and router of one resource
tests/                  one test file per resource
openapi.yaml            the contract of the API
```

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from tests.helpers import author_payload, create_author


def test_create_author(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    payload = author_payload(client, headers)
    response = client.post("/authors", json=payload, headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["id"] is not None
    assert created["name"] == payload["name"]


def test_create_author_without_name(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    payload = author_payload(client, headers)
    del payload["name"]
    response = client.post("/authors", json=payload, headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 400
    error = response.json()["error"]
    assert error["code"] == "validation_error"
    assert any(detail["field"] == "name" for detail in error["details"])


def test_get_author(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    created = create_author(client, headers)
    key = created["id"]
    response = client.get(f"/authors/{key}", headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.json() == created


def test_get_missing_author(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    response = client.get("/authors/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 404
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "not_found"

    create_author(client, headers, variant=1)

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    page = response.json()
    assert page["total"] == 2

    create_author(client, headers)
    create_author(client, headers, variant=1)

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    page = response.json()
    assert page["total"] == 2
    assert len(page["items"]) == 1
    assert page["page"] == 2


def test_list_authors_rejects_a_bad_page(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    response = client.get("/authors", params={"page": 0}, headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 400


def test_replace_author(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    created = create_author(client, headers)
    key = created["id"]
    payload = author_payload(client, headers, variant=1)
    response = client.put(f"/authors/{key}", json=payload, headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.json()["name"] == payload["name"]


def test_update_author(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    created = create_author(client, headers)
    key = created["id"]
    response = client.patch(f"/authors/{key}", json={"name": "name 2"}, headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.json()["name"] == "name 2"

    created = create_author(client, headers)
    key = created["id"]
    response = client.patch(f"/authors/{key}", json={"name": None}, headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 400

    created = create_author(client, headers)
    key = created["id"]
    response = client.delete(f"/authors/{key}", headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 204, response.text
    assert client.get(f"/authors/{key}", headers=headers).status_code == 404

    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "unauthorized"
